messages:
Alex Chen: Heads up — we need to lock a standing cross-functional sync for roadmap + RFC/design reviews. Thinking Tue 9am biweekly as a default. Also want to rotate agenda ownership (eng / product / infra) with a simple round-robin. Thoughts?

Maria Gomez: +1 on rotation. Can we standardize the slot breakdown? Proposal: 15m roadmap updates, 30m RFC/design deep-dive, 10m triage/ops, 5m AOB. Keeps it predictable. :clock1:

Dave Patel: Prefer longer deep-dives for big designs. If we expect large RFCs, 30m feels tight. Maybe alternate weeks: deep-dive week (40m) vs sync week (20m).

Priya Singh: I can run a quick poll for availability and put a tentative invite. Also would be helpful to capture an agenda owner and a decision-logger for each meeting. @Dave can you confirm availability for Tue 9am recurring?

Alex Chen: @Priya thanks. Rotation + decision-logger sounds good. If we do alternating deep-dive weeks we can keep the same cadence but different templates.

calendar-bot: poll created: https://doodle.example/abc123 — tentative event created for Tue 9am biweekly pending votes.

Dave Patel: I can take the infra/ops deep-dive slot for week 3. Also request we add a "rollout & fallback plan" checklist item to all design reviews so we don't skip launch safety.

Maria Gomez: I'll volunteer to own the first meeting and kick off the agenda template (will add rollout checklist). Can someone add a short PR review ping in the triage section so code owners get a nudge?

Alex Chen: Awesome — action items: 1) Priya to send poll (ongoing), 2) Maria owns meeting #1 + shares agenda template, 3) Dave owns infra deep-dive week 3, 4) add decision-log & rollout checklist to template. We'll reconvene async and finalize by EOD Thu.

Priya Singh: Poll sent — please vote by EOD Thursday so I can finalize calendar invites. Thanks :wave:
